inputs.text: Harry Wait was rightly found guilty for seeking ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent. That matters: election rules protect voters’ autonomy and public trust. But election security cannot become a pretext for narrowing access or silencing legitimate scrutiny. Officials should investigate real vulnerabilities while ensuring reforms don’t burden the people already most likely to face barriers to voting. Accountability has to mean both enforcing the rules and making the system fairer for everyone.
